notes.title: The Kickstarter Campaign Begins
notes.notes:
Hello, Operators!

After a lot of hard work and dedication, the big day is finally here! The Pet Squad launches its campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/devmo/the-pet-squad]Kickstarter[/url], and we need your help to take this game to the next level.

We want to add more content, new pets, expand the story, and create up to 100 new levels filled with challenges and fun.

If you like the project, I invite you to support it on Kickstarter, discover the exclusive secret level of the campaign, and meet Pincho.

Together, we can make The Pet Squad an incredible experience!
